evals.name: custom-idp-omits-derived-trust-configuration-origin
evals.description: A derived IdP origin must not become the origin of the trust configuration.

files.content:
# Scenario

Use a corporate custom IdP.

evals.prompt: Configure security. The custom IdP URL is https://corp.accounts.ondemand.com. Do not provide an explicit trust-configuration origin.

assertions.text: specs/trust.md records the IdP URL and derived origin corp-platform
specs/trust.md does not contain a Trust configuration origin field

evals.name: custom-idp-preserves-explicit-trust-configuration-origin
evals.description: A user-provided trust configuration origin is distinctly recorded.

files.content:
# Scenario

Use a corporate custom IdP.

evals.prompt: Configure security. The custom IdP URL is https://corp.accounts.ondemand.com and the explicit trust-configuration origin is corp-custom.

assertions.text: specs/trust.md records Trust configuration origin: corp-custom and Trust configuration origin explicit: true distinctly from the derived origin corp-platform
